title: bi-evals BYO endpoint response
description: Response shape an api_endpoint must return for bi-evals BYO mode. Fields not listed here are ignored. Two keys (text/SQL) can be relocated via `response_text_key` / `response_sql_key` in bi-evals.yaml; the trace/files_read paths are fixed.

sql.description: SQL the agent generated. Either this OR a fenced ```sql block inside `text` is required — bi-evals falls back to fence extraction when `sql` is absent. Key is configurable via `response_sql_key`.

text.description: Natural-language answer from the agent. Optional; if absent, bi-evals uses the raw response body as the text. Key is configurable via `response_text_key`.

files_read.description: List of knowledge/skill files the agent consulted. Enables file-attribution checks in `skill_path_correctness` scoring. If absent, bi-evals derives the list from `trace[].tool_input.path`.

trace.description: Per-step record of the agent's reasoning. Enables `skill_path_correctness` scoring. Each step is one tool call or one text emission. Order matters for sequence-sensitive goldens.

type.description: Step kind. 'tool_use' for tool calls, 'text' for free-text reasoning emitted by the agent.

tool_name.description: Tool the agent called. Required when type='tool_use'.

tool_input.description: Arguments the agent passed to the tool. For file-reading tools, include a `path` field — bi-evals harvests it into `files_read` automatically.

tool_result_preview.description: Optional preview of what the tool returned. Surfaced in the bi-evals viewer; ignored by scoring.
